respuesta.razonamiento: The architecture diagram shows Oportun's sensitive data discovery and remediation pipeline using Amazon Macie across multiple AWS accounts. Across the accounts, Amazon Macie scans S3 buckets for sensitive data (SSNs, ITINs) with metadata findings delivered to a central findings S3 bucket. Amazon Athena queries these findings, which are then visualized in Amazon QuickSight dashboards for security engineers. Data is also loaded into a MySQL data lake, with AWS Glue providing automation. As per Rule 6, multiple instances of the same service acting as one logical multi-account deployment (Macie and S3 across member accounts) are fused into their respective service nodes.
respuesta.nombre: Oportun: Automating Sensitive Data Discovery with Amazon Macie
